items.title: Tag writes >50% of my PRs every day.
items.title_zh: Tag 每天都会写超过 50% 的 PR。
items.description: Tag writes >50% of my PRs every day. It also does ~100% of my data analysis, and fixes most of our product feedback + bugs. It's not like a regular Slack bot. It is proactive, programmable, it has memory, it has access to your connectors.…
items.description_zh: Tag 每天都会写超过 50% 的 PR。它还完成了大约 100% 的数据分析，并修复了我们的大部分产品反馈和错误。它不像普通的 Slack 机器人。它是主动的、可编程的、有内存、可以访问您的连接器……

items.title: What is effort really?
items.description: What is effort really? When do you change it it and why not just use max effort for everything? I dove deep into this problem, looking into evals and doing my own tests and I was quite surprised by the results. https://t.co/KO2D51j34H
items.description_zh: 真正的努力是什么？你什么时候改变它，为什么不尽全力去做每件事呢？我深入研究了这个问题，研究了评估并做了自己的测试，我对结果感到非常惊讶。 https://t.co/KO2D51j34H
